admission.justification: The two test suites declare shared hang guards, advance the named product-timer boundaries on fake time, and observe the named producer opportunities before negative assertions; bounded source scans reject the stated syntactic timing/state classes unless a real comment gives a reviewed reason. No member alone prevents both premature observations and new unmarked machine-speed dependencies.

guarantee: Dashboard tests use centrally configured test, hook and async-query hang guards, and the named negative assertions observe their actual producer opportunities before claiming absence. Python and dashboard source scans reject the specified syntactic timing and mutable-state classes unless a real comment gives a nonempty reviewed reason. The guards bound hangs rather than performance, and the scans do not establish the semantic truth of marker reasons or cover computed bounds and unregistered state. The retired subject-hold product-timer record supplies no current timer-case obligation.
title: Test observations use guards, controlled time and real producer opportunities
